Description: "Wire up sidebar Alerts icon to open the Alerts modal."
Instruction: "Change onClick of notificationIcon to open alerts modal."
ReplacementContent: "          <SidebarIcon id=\"notificationIcon\" isDark={isDark} icon={<Bell size={18} fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" strokeWidth={2} />} active={isAlertsModalOpen} onClick={() => setIsAlertsModalOpen(true)} label=\"Alerts\" />"
TargetContent: "          <SidebarIcon id=\"notificationIcon\" isDark={isDark} icon={<Bell size={18} fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" strokeWidth={2} />} active={false} onClick={() => {}} label=\"Alerts\" />"
